name: microsoft-tfs
description: Microsoft TFS MCP server (Node/TypeScript stdio) — work items, builds, PRs, repos, branches.

token.title: TFS Personal Access Token
token.description: TFS PAT — exported as TFS_TOKEN into the stdio server environment. Create one at {baseUrl}/{DefaultCollection|Company}/_usersSettings/tokens

baseUrl.title: TFS Base URL
baseUrl.description: TFS root URL, without trailing slash — exported as TFS_BASE_URL. Example: http://tfs.example.com:8080/tfs

org.title: TFS Collection / Organization
org.description: TFS collection — exported as TFS_ORG. Default: DefaultCollection
